Requirement/Source Reference: VariablePayService.OverrideAsync (AsNoTracking load, no Update/Attach/ExecuteUpdate, SaveChangesAsync persists nothing)
Preconditions: Tenant A signed in as HRAdmin with Payroll.VariablePay.Override granted and an award exists under a plan version with AllowManualOverride=true, unless stated.
Expected Result: CalculatedAmount=10000, Status=Calculated (unchanged - the override was never persisted, proving the response was a fabricated success)
